summary: cto checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Approve containment-only execution this cycle. No new production requests, requeues, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, spending, credentials, domains, launches, or monetization changes. Preserve existing repair, measurement, attribution, legal, security, ownership, and reconciliation work. Deferred opportunities are technically feasible but not queue-eligible until ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, release, deduplication, security, attribution, and measurement evidence are recorded. Keep private and parked dispositions unchanged; preserve aggregate revenue as unattributed and make no unsupported financial or causal claims.

Continue existing delivery containment and failure-repair review. Do not dispatch or requeue work until dated ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, release, deduplication, security, attribution, and measurement evidence are recorded by the existing deadline.

Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Preserve private launch gates. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.

Continue the existing launch-readiness evidence work and keep the gated product private. Keep permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Do not change launch state, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, or deployment.

Continue the existing revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation only. Preserve aggregate provider earnings as unattributed. Reconcile matching periods and recorded cost categories without inferring site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, cost-to-learn, or causal lift.
